job.title: Clinical Educator | MedTech
job.description:
THE COMPANY YOU WOULD BE JOINING
  • Founded in the 1980’s with over 6000 employees worldwide, this medtech manufacturer is a leading innovator in their niche area of expertise.
  • They support healthcare practitioners every day to diagnose and treat patients with confidence.
  • Their innovative products are designed to achieve outstanding clinical outcomes through detection, diagnosis and overall treatment of disease.
BENEFITS
  • This company is large enough to invest in people and new technology, yet small enough to ensure that every single individual in the business can drive real change for good.
  • Everyone is driven and focused, and they care. They believe in what they do because they know what they do matters. 
  • Ambition is encouraged. They want you to be the best you can be and they will support you to drive your own development and carve your own path.
  • They believe in rewarding talent. So, if you perform well, are truly engaged and keen to make an impact, there will be no shortage of opportunities for you to achieve success.
WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING EACH DAY
  • This Clinical Educator role based in Melbourne, covers the whole of VIC, however, primarily looks after the Eastern side of Melbourne.
  • The position involves providing clinical guidance to surgical customers, via case support in theatre as well as education and in-servicing in clinical settings. The role heavily involves maintaining and building customer relationships by providing excellent field and product support in a hospital environment.
  • The role works very closely with Territory Managers (sales) to support specific territories, hospitals and regional areas to promote all the company’s surgical products to meet established sales objectives and goals.
  • You will provide surgical procedure and technical product support in surgery as well as ongoing customer service and identify new business growth opportunities and develop business in the current customer portfolio.
  • You will identify customer needs, deliver ongoing market analysis, market intelligence and competition assessment and attend cases, sales calls with sales as required, build rapport, communicate technical products and operations programs to surgeons, physicians, nursing staff, hospital administration, health-care providers, and others as needed.
  • You will address customer concerns and escalate calls that require manager involvement and assist with various sales activities as needed.
WHAT EXPERIENCE/SKILLS WILL YOU NEED TO GET THE JOB?
  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university preferred.
  • Be comfortable in an operating theatre/surgical field.
  • Demonstrated ability to understand and simplify highly technical or scientific concepts when communicating to others.
  • Excellent interpersonal, presentation and listening skills.
  • Highly organised, excellent time management + customer service skills.
  • Expertise in Microsoft Windows and Office, specifically Outlook, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • As this position requires driving during the workday, a valid driving license and satisfactory driving record, as well as a serviceable vehicle available for work use is mandatory (a car allowance is included in the salary package).
  • Travel as necessary, which may include 20-30% overnight travel to support regional and interstate customers.
Interested? Please 'apply now' quoting reference number 3896 or call Nicole Villanueva on 0414.919.461. Please note, your details/resume will not be sent anywhere without a formal interview and, if successful, your subsequent prior permission. Personal information provided will be used for recruitment purposes only and be treated in the strictest confidence. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

job.title: Senior Biomedical Engineer | Medical Devices
job.description:
THE COMPANY YOU WOULD BE JOINING
  • This medical device company has been supporting surgeons, doctors and clinicians for over 60 years and has grown into a worldwide manufacturer and distributor of some of the best medical technology in their niche space.
  • This organisation combines their expertise in medical devices with software solutions to achieve integration in the operating theatre environment and to support clinical procedures and resource management.
WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU
  • This company offers you amazing opportunities to actually make an impact.
  • They consistently challenge and support their people’s personal and professional development.
  • They are always interested in recruiting great people to enable them to continue to play a pioneering role as a leading manufacturer of medical devices and medical technology.
WHAT YOU WILL LEAD AND GROW
  • This Senior Biomedical Engineer position, based in Auckland, NZ is responsible for managing the end-to-end service and operational delivery of biomedical equipment across New Zealand, including overseeing the NZ workshop and ensuring the full-service lifecycle for customer accounts is delivered efficiently and to a high standard.
  • The role involves performing complex technical repairs and maintenance, while also handling administrative and logistical aspects of service operations, operating with a high degree of independence in daily decision-making. The manager of this role is based in Sydney.
  • The position will oversee the day-to-day operations of the New Zealand workshop, including equipment intake, job prioritisation, and maintaining an organised and efficient workspace, along with maintaining accurate and up-to-date service records, job tracking, and work orders within SAP and the Quality Management System, ensuring all documentation is audit-ready at all times.
  • You will inspect, test, and repair loan and demonstration equipment to ensure availability meets the needs of the sales and customer teams and drive a proactive and strategic approach to asset lifecycle management by identifying aging equipment, prioritising service or replacement needs, and aligning actions with customer requirements and service contract commitments.
  • You will conduct safety and performance testing of equipment in compliance with applicable regulatory standards, including ANZ 3551, and internal company requirements and deliver both preventative maintenance and responsive repair services across the New Zealand hospital customer base to ensure optimal equipment performance and reliability.
  • You will diagnose and resolve complex technical issues independently, escalating where necessary to ensure timely and effective resolution and install and validate software updates, manage system integrations, and troubleshoot related issues to maintain and enhance overall equipment functionality and performance.
  • You will apply sound knowledge of hospital and surgical environments, including relevant standards such as AS/NZS 3551 and AS/NZS 3200 and demonstrate working knowledge of ISO 13485 and its application within medical device servicing and quality processes.
WHAT EXPERIENCE & SKILLS WILL YOU NEED TO GET THE JOB?
  • A degree or diploma in Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 5+ years’ experience in biomedical engineering or a medical device service role in the medical device industry.
  • EWRB registration (EST/Electrician) with MCPA endorsement, or willingness to obtain.
  • Experience in the installation, maintenance, and servicing of capital medical equipment.
  • Exposure to laser equipment, particularly in testing and validation, is highly desirable, but not mandatory.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and manage a regional workload with minimal supervision.
  • A full, current New Zealand driver’s licence and legal eligibility to work in New Zealand.
  • Strong technical troubleshooting, diagnostic and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience working within hospital/clinical environments and relevant medical device quality standards.
INTERESTED?

Personal information provided will be used for recruitment purposes only and be treated in the strictest confidence. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

job.title: Marketing + Design Coordinator - TEMP ASSIGNMENT
job.description:
THE COMPANY YOU WOULD BE JOINING
  • This professional membership body for the medical technology industry aims to ensure the benefits of modern, innovative and reliable medical technologies are delivered effectively to provide better health outcomes to the Australian community by working with industry professionals & organisations in medical devices. 
WHAT YOU WILL LEAD
  • Temporary Marketing & Design Coordinator assignment, starting immediately through to the end of the year, with the possibility of extension.
  • Full-time, five days per week in their Macquarie Park office, with free onsite parking; after the first five weeks, enjoy 1–2 work-from-home days per week.
  • Create engaging event marketing campaigns for conferences, forums, webinars, awards and member events.
  • Develop on-brand social media content, including posts, graphics, short videos, speaker highlights and sponsor recognition.
  • Design digital and print event collateral, including invitations, programs, signage, presentation templates, email graphics and social tiles.
  • Support event communications across websites, registration pages and email campaigns, ensuring content is accurate, clear and up to date.
  • Coordinate campaign schedules, key deadlines and event assets while working closely with internal teams, speakers, sponsors, venues and suppliers.
  • Assist with event-day marketing activity and post-event communications, including photography, social content, highlights and campaign reporting.
WHAT EXPERIENCE & SKILLS YOU WILL NEED
  • Experience in event marketing, communications, social media, graphic design or a similar coordination role.
  • A Diploma of Graphic Design or equivalent relevant qualification (preferred but not mandatory).
  • A strong portfolio showcasing event campaigns, social content and digital or print design work.
  • Hands-on Adobe InDesign experience is essential; WordPress, Illustrator and Photoshop experience is highly regarded.
  • Strong design skills, with an eye for layout, typography, colour, imagery and brand consistency.
  • Confident writing and editing skills for social media, emails, event pages and attendee communications.
  • Excellent attention to detail, organisational skills and ability to manage multiple deadlines.
  • A collaborative approach, with the confidence to work with teams, speakers, sponsors, venues and suppliers.

job.title: Clinical Territory Manager | Medical Consumables
job.description:
THE COMPANY YOU WOULD BE JOINING
  • An independent, Australian owned company specialising in the supply of medical device products to the ANZ healthcare markets.
  • Established in the 1990’s, this organisation promotes and sells the best products and brands globally in this niche therapy area and their innovative products are promoted based on clinical evidence.
  • Their growth has been achieved by valuing their customers and employees, who have contributed to the company’s ongoing success.
WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU
  • Looking for a collaborative, family friendly culture and company who values their people?
  • Step up to an amazing role working for a great company who will mentor and guide your career in the right direction.
WHAT YOU WILL LEAD AND GROW
  • You will call on and sell to clinical customers within the hospital environment, primarily in metro North West Melbourne and will look after regional areas (on occasion) around Shepparton, Bendigo, Ballarat and Albury, to establish relationships to promote and sell medical consumables.
  • You will manage your own time with total autonomy on a daily basis and be able to develop a sales and account development strategy to achieve your sales targets. 
WHAT EXPERIENCE & SKILLS WILL YOU NEED TO GET THE JOB?
  • This is a great opportunity for someone who is a nurse or results-driven sales professional who has consistently demonstrated excellent performance within the medical consumables/devices sector or pharmaceutical industry as a GP Rep. You will be a few years into your career and if a nurse, keen to move into a commercial role.
